# search

Types from PocketBase's Go package `search`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [search](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/search).

## search.Join

Join defines common fields required for a single SQL JOIN clause.

| `tableAlias` | <code>string</code> |  |

## search.ResolverResult

ResolverResult defines a single FieldResolver.Resolve() successfully parsed result.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `identifier` | <code>string</code> | Identifier is the plain SQL identifier/column that will be used in the final db expression as left or right operand. |
| `nullFallback` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/search#searchnullfallbackpreference">NullFallbackPreference</a></code> | NullFallback specify the preference for how NULL or empty values should be resolved (default to "auto"). |
| `params` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxparams">dbx.Params</a></code> | Params is a map with db placeholder->value pairs that will be added to the query when building both resolved operands/sides in a single expression. |
| `multiMatchSubQuery?` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/search#searchmultimatchsubquery">MultiMatchSubquery</a></code> | MultiMatchSubQuery is an optional sub query expression that will be added in addition to the combined ResolverResult expression during build. |
| `afterBuild` | <code>(expr: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexpression">dbx.Expression</a>) =&gt; <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexpression">dbx.Expression</a></code> | AfterBuild is an optional function that will be called after building and combining the result of both resolved operands/sides in a single expression. |
